whatsNew: Admin App Updater now includes Refresh version, which automatically reads the latest Android versionName, versionCode and What's New from the release files and fills the updater fields for you.
Refresh version only stages the release details; it does not enable or trigger an update for users.
This release is staged as v1.0.47 • build 48 and is ready to be triggered manually from Admin when you choose.
Pinch-to-zoom in and out is now enabled in the Android app, starting at the compact 85% zoom level.
Pinching with two fingers no longer conflicts with the app's pull-to-refresh gesture, preventing an accidental page reload while zooming.
The bottom-center Home button is smaller and redesigned with a premium gold finish, illuminated edge, depth, halo and a properly clipped circular logo.
The Android startup screen now shows a larger, fully branded E-Football logo on a dark cinematic background instead of a blank white page.
The Android 12+ launch experience has also been branded so the system splash and in-app splash transition use the E-Football identity.
The homepage Menu control has been upgraded with stronger contrast, a darker cinematic glass surface, gold detailing, glow, depth and clearer icon treatment.
The Menu drawer has been upgraded into a higher-contrast glass panel with clearer sections, active states and improved visibility over the pirate background.
The website footer and Android release metadata are synchronized to v1.0.47 / build 48.
Release What's New is now designed to describe the actual changes in the current release instead of carrying unrelated older release notes.
